Title: New tournament format: Short Attention Span Jyhad

Messages.Author: BenPeal
Messages.Body:
Introducing Short Attention Span Jyhad!

Ok, so, it's just like a normal tournament except you ignore the last line of card text from every library card. You might already be playing that way anyway!

Mergen, can we get this scheduled for Origins?
